description: Pinned-digest golden fixtures (Global Constraints, program §7.14, design §16). Digests are sha256 over the canonical-JSON serialization (code-unit sorted keys, I-JSON integers only) produced by testing/src/backend-local/canonical.ts's `serializeCanonicalFixture`. Each entry includes at least one object-key-sort-sensitive record.

entries.name: journal-to-observation-projection
entries.canonicalizationNote: each event projects to {id, subject, type} with id = `${source}/${attemptId}/${seq}`; the array is emitted in journal seq order (already sorted — the object-key-sort-sensitivity is inside each element, not the array order)

entries.name: launch-plan-out-of-source-order-keys
entries.canonicalizationNote: the source record below is written with argv/blameExitCodes/cwd/env/interruptionBehavior/resultContract/validExitCodes intentionally out of alphabetical order (resultContract, argv, validExitCodes, cwd, interruptionBehavior, env, blameExitCodes) — this is the object-key-sort-sensitive record Global Constraints requires; the canonical serializer must still emit code-unit-sorted keys regardless of source order
